question_cn: 通路兵的最终价值取决于：
question_en: The ultimate value of a passed pawn depends on:

options.text_cn: 通路兵本身的位置（高级通路兵更强）
options.text_en: The passed pawn's rank (advanced passer is stronger)

options.text_cn: 王能否支援通路兵推进，且对方王无法及时拦截
options.text_en: Whether own king can support it while enemy king can't intercept in time

options.text_cn: 通路兵旁边有没有兵保护
options.text_en: Whether the passed pawn has a neighboring pawn for protection

options.text_cn: 通路兵是a兵还是中心兵
options.text_en: Whether the passed pawn is an a-pawn or a center pawn

explanation_cn: 通路兵价值的元思维：通路兵的威力在于"兑现"——王能护送且对方王追不上时，通路兵才是决定性的。只有通路兵而王位不佳，对方王及时拦截，通路兵可以毫无价值。
explanation_en: Meta-concept: a passed pawn's power lies in converting — it's decisive only when own king can escort it and enemy king can't intercept. A passed pawn with a passive king can be worthless.
